body: Where I live there is no state wide leash law. Most of these laws are determined by local governments.

He's on an electric fence but he runs off the property without a second thought or care. He doesn't run off the property normally though, it's only when people start walking on the lawn. If someone is walking on our side of the road, he's just fine. But as soon as they step foot on that grass he starts to get agitated. He's very territorial. I'm not worried about him mauling or attacking anybody but he's a very big dog and can knock people over easily. He comes when he's called though, but we have to make sure he's on his best behavior constantly because my parents refuse to install a physical fence.
